name: vercel-react-view-transitions
title_zh: 路由切换不白屏，原生过渡动画直接写进 React
tagline_zh: 页面跳转像原生 App 一样顺滑，不用引 framer-motion。共享元素、列表重排、前进后退方向感。
tagline_en: Route changes feel native without heavy animation libs. Shared elements, list reorder, directional.
desc_en: Guide for implementing smooth, native-feeling animations using React's View Transition API (`<ViewTransition>` component, `addTransitionType`, and CSS view transition pseudo-elements). Use this skill whenever the user wants to add page transitions, animate route changes, create shared element animations, animate enter/exit of components, animate list reorder, implement directional (forward/back) n
why_zh: 它把浏览器原生过渡能力封装成 React 组件，不额外引入动画库，性能开销小，且能感知前进/后退方向。
why_en: Wraps the browser's native View Transition API into React components—zero extra animation deps, low overhead, and.
limit_zh: 只支持 Chromium 系浏览器（Chrome/Edge 111+），Safari/Firefox 不生效。
limit_en: Chromium-only (Chrome/Edge 111+); no-op in Safari/Firefox. Covers view transitions only—no drag, scroll-driven, or gesture-based animations.
title_en: Native view transitions for React routes & lists
